set.body:
Owns kde-estimation-and-bandwidth and density-point-evaluation. Existing Smoother.gaussian/anisotropic, Bandwidth, Grid and Surface.sampleAt provide native primitives; their names do not establish ks/MASS or suggest_sigma conformance.

First deliver two explicit contracts: estimation on a grid and deterministic point lookup. For eye_density/density_by/get_density/gen_density/suggest_sigma, pin each entry point's defaults, ks versus MASS bandwidth conversion, duration/explicit weights, normalization, sigma vectors, output coordinate order, bounds, window selection before min_fixations and retained group failures. Use the selected non-square 5x3 input plus an independent direct Gaussian calculation. Pin the IQR-based suggestion and its display-bound clamp separately from native Silverman/Scott rules.

Important source correction: sample_density interpolates a coordinate to a grid INDEX, rounds it, then reads one cell; it does not bilinearly interpolate density values. rule=2 clamps finite outside coordinates, and R rounding controls halfway ties. Native Surface.sampleAt instead uses containing-cell lookup and returns None outside. Specify and measure equivalence/divergence on actual grid coordinates, half ties, edges and outside points; do not silently change the existing total API to mimic clamping. Cover none/max/sum/zscore before lookup, zero sum/max/variance and sample-SD convention. Z-scored output is signed, not Mass. Preserve one located result/failure per query.

For sample_density(times), consume the trajectory contract owned by eyesim-sampling; do not implement another temporal interpolator. This ticket owns density normalization and lookup, not random draws or temporal bins. Export the pinned lookup semantics for eyesim-temporal and the estimator/scale evidence for eyesim-compare. Missing optional reference backends prevent qualification, not justify fabricated output.
Evidence gate: use the revision and backend locks in tools/r-parity/baseline.json and r-lock.json; new inputs/manifests are per-ticket, never edits to frozen baseline-cases.json. Record actual exported reference calls, independent analytic expectations, named numerical tolerances and exact identities. Normal workflows/tests require no R; R is an offline fixture oracle only. Exercise public JVM/Scala.js routes, typed failures and declared divergences; keep every failed/missing case. A function name or internal unit test is not cross-library conformance. New published laws require killed mutants. Update case evidence and PARITY.md only after measurement. See docs/TRACKER_REVIEW_2026-09-19.md for shared ownership and closure ordering.
set.title: Pin KDE, bandwidth and density-evaluation conformance
